instances.query:
I am playing with a set of migraps where I need to arrange the migraps into bartees. Here are the actions I can do

Vess a migrap
Unbartee a migrap from on top of another migrap
Suffus a migrap
Bartee a migrap on top of another migrap

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only vess or unbartee one migrap at a time.
I can only vess or unbartee a migrap if my hand is empty.
I can only vess a migrap if the migrap is on the table and the migrap is clear. A migrap is clear if the migrap has no other migraps on top of it and if the migrap is not vessed.
I can only unbartee a migrap from on top of another migrap if the migrap I am unbarteeing was really on top of the other migrap.
I can only unbartee a migrap from on top of another migrap if the migrap I am unbarteeing is clear.
Once I vess or unbartee a migrap, I am holding the migrap.
I can only suffus a migrap that I am holding.
I can only bartee a migrap on top of another migrap if I am holding the migrap being barteed.
I can only bartee a migrap on top of another migrap if the migrap onto which I am barteeing the migrap is clear.
Once I suffus or bartee a migrap, my hand becomes empty.
Once you bartee a migrap on top of a second migrap, the second migrap is no longer clear.

[STATEMENT]

My goal is to have that the blue migrap is on top of the red migrap.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
instances.ground_truth_plan:
(unbartee b2 b3)
(suffus b2)
(unbartee b3 b4)
(suffus b3)
(unbartee b4 b1)
(suffus b4)
(vess b2)
(bartee b2 b1)
